title: [Enhancement] Optionally use the YouTube API for improved fast indexing
body_excerpt:
## What's new?

- Adds the ability to use the YouTube API for fast indexing if you want the most reliable results
   - Current behaviour is maintained by default - this is purely opt-in
   - Falls back to RSS if there is an error with the YouTube API
   - Resolves #280 

## What's changed?

- Documentation around fast indexing - both in-app and in the Wiki

## What's fixed?

N/A

N/A
